_README: Copy this file to configs/<YOURNAME>.json, fill in the values below, then run: ./Manage-MrmConfig.ps1 -Action Encrypt -ConfigPath ./configs/<YOURNAME>.json  (it will prompt for the client secret, hidden, and add ClientSecretEncrypted). Never put a real secret in this template.
_auth: Pick ONE. Certificate is preferred. For a client secret leave the two certificate fields out entirely and let -Action Encrypt add ClientSecretEncrypted.
_optional: Remove any line you do not need.
